[chapter id="ch02-wataame" title="Chapter 2 - Lake Morning (cotton candy)"]
[bg file="bg/lake.png"]
[ch file="ch/jolly.png" pos="left"]
[text]Next morning. Wooden dock on a mountain lake. Mist, church bells, sparkling sun.[/text]
[text speaker="Jolly"]The cotton candy melted a little... now it is a tiny pink cloud hat.[/text]
[text speaker="Jolly"]The lake is so sparkly. Should I skip a stone, or sit and watch the mist?[/text]
[choose id="lake-choice"]
[option id="skip" label="Skip a flat stone across the lake"]Skip a stone.[/option]
[option id="sit" label="Sit on the dock and watch the mist lift"]Sit and watch.[/option]
[/choose]
[label id="after-skip"]
[text speaker="Jolly"]One... two... three skips! The orb counted for me.[/text]
[text]Ripples cross the whole lake, turning the morning sun into a thousand tiny festivals.[/text]
[goto stub-end]
[label id="after-sit"]
[text speaker="Jolly"]If I sit very still, the mist sits with me. We are both clouds today.[/text]
[text]Slowly the mist lifts. The village across the lake appears, house by house, like a story being told.[/text]
[label id="stub-end"]
[text speaker="Jolly"]Stub Chapter 2 complete. The generated version adds fresh art and beats. (The End)[/text]
[end]
